data.description:
Operator-approved early removal (pre-1.0 breaking pass #3), 2026-08-12. Source: the DEPRECATION REMOVAL-READINESS SURVEY, comment #11 on childsafe-bizarre-lorikeet (b902-18af-14ed-4da1), Tier 1 item 1 — the only genuinely expired, genuinely dead surface found. Operator ruling (verbatim): "The two best candidates and the one ready now are all approved for removal."

WHAT: delete the dead `.gitattributes` migration arm that strips the retired `.reconciler-* merge=ours` line from an already-initialized tracker.

WHY DEAD: the reconciler pass-lock/phase-gate moved onto `refs/reconciler/*` (epic dust-troth-naval / C4), so the carve-out was retired; this store ALREADY ran the strip — `git log origin/tickets -- .gitattributes` shows exactly two commits, the second being 826d5ae379 "drop retired .reconciler-* merge=ours", and the live blob contains only `.bridge_state/* merge=ours`. The arm is permanently unreachable here. Residual risk, accepted by the operator ruling: a clone that has not swept since 2026-07-05 would no longer be converged by init.

SCOPE (current main): `src/rebar/_commands/init.py` — the `_RETIRED_GITATTRIBUTES_LINES` constant (~line 69) plus its explanatory comment, and the migration arm at the tail of the gitattributes ensure-unit (~lines 600-616), which becomes an unconditional "converged" return. ~15 LOC, one src file, plus any test that exercised the strip.

NOT IN SCOPE: the gitattributes ensure-unit itself (it still creates `.gitattributes` on a fresh tracker and is School-B convergent — see docs/migrations.md), and the `.bridge_state/* merge=ours` line.

ACs:
1. `_RETIRED_GITATTRIBUTES_LINES` and the strip arm are gone from `src/rebar/_commands/init.py`; the ensure-unit returns "ok/.gitattributes converged" for any existing committed `.gitattributes`.
2. Fresh-tracker creation of `.gitattributes` is unchanged (still writes the `.bridge_state/* merge=ours` block).
3. Any test asserting the strip behaviour is removed or retargeted; `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and the init/ensure-registry tests pass.
4. A release-notes entry records this under the pre-1.0 breaking pass #3 window, following the format of the two prior passes (docs/release-notes.md, DE7 and the ticket-5899 sibling pass).
5. No deprecation-registry or tombstone row is involved (this surface never had one — it is internal store convergence, not a user-facing input).
data.title: Remove dead .reconciler-* gitattributes strip arm
